svg.title: Applicability Branches for Prerecorded Audio and Video
svg.desc: The sequence for checking whether media is prerecorded, the original media type, the exception for media alternatives to text, and the information in the original and alternative.

g.text: Verify the original and the content actually provided, then compare the alternative's quality.
Actual live content goes to other criteria · Review replays as prerecorded
② Information composition of the original
Audio-only → Alternative for time-based media, such as a transcript
Video-only → Text alternative or sufficient audio description
Video and audio together → Check applicable criteria for captions, audio description, and more
③ Exception for an alternative to existing text
No additional information absent from the text + Clearly labeled alternative relationship
Both verified with evidence → Record the exception reason / Either unverified → Inconclusive
④ Compare whether the actual alternative conveys the same information
Connect information, conditions, speakers, actions, sequence, and results to the original
Unable to process materials → Record errors, blocked access, and unreviewed scope separately
Out of scope ≠ Exception ≠ Insufficient evidence · Do not turn these three reasons into “pass.”
